entry.title: 🧠 Demystifying Metrics in Kubernetes
entry.summary: Kubernetes does not magically know when to scale your workloads 🤖 metrics exposed through dedicated APIs to make scaling decisions. There are three types of metrics you need to understand: ⚙️ Resource Metrics Each one represents a different kind of pressure on your system. Autoscaling in Kubernetes is mainly handled by the Horizontal Pod Autoscaler (HPA). The HPA keeps asking: “Hey… are my Pods struggling?” 😅 The answer comes from metrics. Without them, Kubernetes is basically guessing. These are the native Kubernetes metrics. They come from the Metrics Server and only cover: 🧮 CPU usage They are exposed via: metrics.k8s.io They describe resource consumption, not business traffic. Your app might be slow because of a database… but CPU could still be chill 🧊 apiVersion: autoscaling/v2 ki…
